text: The 50-year durability of ER-13.04 shall be demonstrated by the cover, concrete quality and crack width limits above and by a chloride ingress check per fib Model Code / EN 1992 for the XS3 elements. Concrete shall be cured for at least 7 days; the permeability (water penetration depth per EN 12390-8) shall not exceed 30 mm and the chloride migration coefficient (NT Build 492) shall not exceed 8 x 10^-12 m2/s at 28 days for XS3 concrete.
